baseline.method: Independent original fastddm 0.3.15, complete paired native movies

metric_definition: For each condition and each parameter separately: L2 estimate-reference / L2 reference. Speed: abs(estimate/reference-1). Direct consistency: L2 predicted-observed structure functions / L2 observed, all 39 q bins and nine fixed lags. No alignment, scaling, cropping or offset fitting.
v2_definition: Accept all positive A/Gamma/speed and beta>=1 compressed-exponential fields satisfying original direct-nine-delay relative L2<=.02 independently per recording. Recording1 beta=1.35. Speed equals exp(mean(log(Gamma/q))) to relative1e-6. No hidden parameter-map comparison.
